sources.collection_method: Overpass QL query over bbox (S,W,N,E) 39.9545,116.3105,40.0380,116.5215; way/relation geometry for building, highway, railway, waterway, leisure, landuse
sources.transformations: EPSG:4326 -> EPSG:4548 (pyproj); residential ways are selected only when landuse=residential and their boundary lines intersect the fixed design screening envelope; emitted lines are clipped to that envelope; no OSM polygon area or line length is calculated or published
sources.usage: Background urban context and lead-finding only. Used to render figure assets/figures/typical-section-AA.png and to emit low-confidence residential-interface verification leads in geometry/constraints.geojson.
sources.usage_limits: NOT used for boundaries, declared areas, lengths, ratios, road right-of-way, statutory control, households, tenure, vulnerability, ownership, loss, causation, compensation, or responsibility assignment. Every OSM feature in constraints.geojson is an analysis_helper line and is excluded from metrics.
sources.known_limitations: Crowd-sourced completeness varies; building levels and ground-floor use are largely absent; two distinct polygons share the name '京张铁路遗址公园' (way 122348403 / 1190723117), so any single-polygon measurement is unstable and is deliberately not published.
sources.cross_check_status: not_cross_checked - awaiting official survey / regulatory plan data
